legacy_inventory.local_acceptance_note: The existing README describes reviewed conversions, but this review did not reconcile each retained file against the newer source-acceptance gate. No local file is newly accepted by this register.

policy: A human-reviewed official link is usable for ordinary research within the identified publisher, instrument, language, displayed date or cutoff, reviewed content, and limitations. A government-published consolidated text is preferred when available. No Gazette-fragment reconstruction, local capture, hash, replay, conversion, API access, or copying permission is required for link use. Check a specific later amendment only when it may materially affect the issue. Link acceptance is separate from local-copy acceptance, topic coverage, and country completion.

ro-portal-208825.publisher: Portal Legislativ, Romanian Government legal-information portal
ro-portal-208825.version_or_cutoff: Portal page displayed consolidated-form history through 8 March 2024.
ro-portal-208825.scope: Official consolidated record for OUG nr. 102/2005 on free movement of EU, EEA, and Swiss citizens in Romania and the associated family-member framework.
ro-portal-208825.reviewed_content: The page identifies the instrument and publisher, shows a consolidated-form selector and dated history, and provides the statutory contents and article links.
limitations: The displayed consolidation cutoff is 8 March 2024; later material changes must be checked when they affect the provision at issue.
This source-reference decision is not an article-by-article legal coverage finding and does not establish that every family route or procedure is adequately covered.
It does not accept the existing local conversion or any attachment as a local artifact.

ro-portal-140280.publisher: Portal Legislativ, Romanian Government legal-information portal
ro-portal-140280.version_or_cutoff: Portal page displayed consolidated-form history through 3 November 2024.
ro-portal-140280.scope: Official consolidated OUG nr. 51/2008 on public legal aid in civil matters, including administrative matters listed in Article 3.
ro-portal-140280.reviewed_content: The page identifies the act and date history. Articles 1–5 were reviewed: they describe legal aid's access-to-justice purpose, covered applicants including persons domiciled or habitually resident in another EU Member State, covered administrative cases, and the financial-needs condition.
limitations: This previously missing source is now recorded as an official link; it is not added to the local-copy or monitoring manifest.
The displayed cutoff is 3 November 2024; check a later material change when relevant.
The eligibility calculation, evidence, application process, available aid and its interaction with administrative proceedings still require topic-level review.

ro-portal-309058.publisher: Portal Legislativ, Romanian Government legal-information portal
ro-portal-309058.version_or_cutoff: CCR Decision nr. 664 of 25 November 2025, published in Monitorul Oficial nr. 268 on 2 April 2026.
ro-portal-309058.scope: Official constitutional-court decision concerning Article 9 of Law nr. 554/2004 and court challenges involving government ordinances.
ro-portal-309058.reviewed_content: The page identifies the issuing court, decision, publication, subject and operative part. The constitutional challenge was rejected as unfounded.
limitations: The decision is not migration-specific and does not resolve an immigration merits issue.
It is a single decision, not a complete interpretation of Article 9 or a substitute for checking the statute and other relevant decisions.
This link does not accept the local conversion or any broader case-law summary.
